hooks.name: accelerator
hooks.reason: Recognizes AMD workload GPUs in a Server's inventory by provider vendor name or by the 1002 PCI vendor id, which a GPU inventory record cannot say by itself.

tasks.name: Check the AMD GPUs' RAS and error records

validations.title: AMD GPU basics
validations.description: Checks that the amdgpu driver brings up every AMD GPU each Server has on PCI, and that every GPU it brings up allocates, fills, and frees memory through the HIP runtime, three times. A Server without an AMD GPU skips both checks.

expectedGpus.title: Expected GPUs
expectedGpus.description: The GPUs the driver must bring up on each Server. Default: the AMD GPUs on its PCI bus, without those passed through to VMs.

checks.title: Driver brings up the GPUs
checks.description: The kernel's KFD topology lists as many GPUs as are expected.

checks.title: HIP probe
checks.description: Every GPU the driver brings up allocates, fills, and frees memory through the HIP runtime, three times.

validations.title: AMD GPU RAS and error records
validations.description: Reads, without changing anything, what the amdgpu driver reports about each Server's AMD GPUs: that RAS is on, the uncorrectable and correctable error counts, and the CPER error records the driver keeps, exported and decoded through AMD SMI. A Server without an AMD GPU skips every check; when the driver keeps a CPER ring for none of its GPUs, the two CPER checks are skipped.

maxCorrectable.title: Correctable errors allowed per GPU
maxCorrectable.description: The correctable errors each GPU may have counted, and the corrected CPER records each GPU with a CPER ring may have written, before the check fails. Default: none; correctable errors are recorded, not judged.

checks.title: RAS is on
checks.description: Every AMD GPU the amdgpu driver drives has a RAS interface whose feature mask is not zero.

checks.title: Error counts
checks.description: No GPU has counted an uncorrectable error; with maxCorrectable, no GPU has counted more correctable errors than that.

checks.title: CPER export
checks.description: AMD SMI exports the CPER records of the driver's CPER ring; no record is a pass.

checks.title: CPER records
checks.description: No exported CPER record is fatal or uncorrected; with maxCorrectable, the corrected records stay within it per GPU. Each record's AFID is decoded and classified.
